buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED.

3. Purchase Preference (Centre) Bid reserved for Make In India products: Procurement under this bid is reserved for purchase from Class 1 local suppliers as defined in public procurement (Preference to Make in India), Order 2017 as amended from time to time and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Nodal Ministry for specific Goods/Products. The minimum local content to qualify as a class 1 local supplier is denoted in the bid document 50%. All bidders must upload a certificate from the OEM regarding the percentage of the local content and the details of locations at which the local value addition is made along with their bid, failing which the bid is liable to be rejected. In case the bid value is more than Rs 10 Crore, the declaration relating to percentage of local content shall be certified by the statutory auditor or cost auditor, if the OEM is a company and by a practicing cost accountant or a chartered accountant for OEMs other than companies as per the Public Procurement (preference to Make-in -India) order 2017 dated 04.06.2020 . In case Buyer has selected Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises clause in the bid, the same will get precedence over this clause. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BUYER ADDED ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) FOR PROFESSIONAL PAINTING SERVICE 1. Scope of Work The service provider shall execute painting work at the locations specified in the attached Scope of Work a nd Schedule of Quantities. The quoted price shall cover the specified materials, labour, surface preparatio n, tools, scaffolding, transportation, protective arrangements, cleaning and disposal of debris. 2. Registration and Statutory Documents The bidder shall upload the following documents with the technical bid: a. PAN of the bidding entity; in the case of a proprietorship, PAN of the proprietor. b. Valid GST Registration Certificate, wherever registration is legally applicable. A bidder claiming non-appl icability shall submit a declaration stating the grounds. c. Constitution/registration document of the firm, partnership, company or other bidding entity, as applicab le. d. Authorisation in favour of the person signing the bid, wherever applicable. 3. Income Tax Returns The bidder shall upload Income Tax Return acknowledgements for the last three financial years specified i n the bid: 4. Balance Sheets and Financial Statements The bidder shall upload Balance Sheets and Profit and Loss Accounts for the last three financial years speci fied above, duly audited wherever statutory audit is applicable. Where statutory audit is not applicable, the bidder may submit financial statements certified by a practisin g Chartered Accountant, together with a declaration regarding non-applicability of statutory audit. CA certi ficates shall bear UDIN, wherever required. 5. Average Annual Turnover The bidder shall meet the minimum average annual turnover requirement of as specified in the system-ge nerated GeM bid. A year-wise turnover certificate issued by a practising Chartered Accountant, bearing UDIN, shall be uploa ded along with supporting financial statements. The certificate shall clearly state the turnover for each pre scribed financial year and the average annual turnover. Applicable exemptions/relaxations shall be available strictly in accordance with the GeM bid provisions and applicable procurement rules. 6. Experience in Similar Work

The bidder shall meet the experience requirement specified in the GeM bid. Similar work means interior/ex terior building painting, whitewashing, distempering or comparable surface-coating work relevant to the te ndered scope. Experience shall be supported by work orders/contracts and completion or satisfactory performance certifi cates showing the nature, value and period of execution. Applicable exemptions/relaxations shall be governed by the published bid conditions. 7. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) The bidder shall furnish EMD of 30000 in the form, validity and manner specified in the system-generated GeM bid. Bidders eligible for EMD exemption shall upload valid supporting documents establishing their eligibility un der the applicable GeM provisions. No EMD shall be demanded from a bidder entitled to exemption. Refund, release and forfeiture of EMD shall be governed by the applicable GeM terms and bid conditions. 8. Non-Debarment Declaration The bidder shall submit a signed declaration confirming that, as on the bid closing date, it is not subject to any subsisting debarment order that renders it ineligible to participate in this procurement. Details of any relevant subsisting order shall be disclosed. 10. Materials and Technical Specifications All paints, primers, putty and other materials shall be new, genuine, within their recommended shelf life a nd compliant with the technical specifications and applicable Indian Standards, wherever prescribed. The paint type, grade, finish, number of coats and surface-preparation requirements shall be as stated in t he attached technical specifications. Colour shades shall be approved by the Buyer before application. Materials shall be brought to the site in original sealed containers and made available for inspection before use. 11. Surface Preparation and Execution The service provider shall carry out scraping, cleaning, removal of loose paint, filling of minor cracks, sandi ng, putty application and priming to the extent specified in the Scope of Work. Painting shall be undertaken on properly prepared surfaces in accordance with the material manufacturer’ s application instructions. Finished surfaces shall be uniform and free from peeling, blistering, patchiness, sagging and visible application defects. 12. Protection and Safety The service provider shall protect furniture, floors, doors, windows, electrical fittings and other existing ass ets during execution. Damage attributable to its operations shall be rectified at its own cost. The service provider shall arrange safe scaffolding, personal protective equipment, barricading and necess ary supervision, and shall comply with applicable labour, wage and safety requirements. . 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of District Megistrate payable at Amroha . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date.
